structured_output.summary: The diff implements every step of Iterator.prototype.forEach in spec order, and each step has its comment. Step 4 calls IteratorClose with a throw completion and a record whose NextMethod is undefined, as the spec requires. Step 5 does GetIteratorDirect only after the callable check. The loop uses IteratorStepValue and Call, closes the iterator on an abrupt call result, and returns undefined when done. The counter saturates at 2^53, which matches Number addition (2^53+1 rounds back to 2^53). Errors propagate with `?`, and there are no special cases or made-up values. Rooting is added around the user-code calls. All 54 target tests pass with no regressions, and only the one in-scope file changed.
